_note: Broad evaluation set, v2. Written in one pass BEFORE any tuning against it, and measured once before anything was changed — so the first numbers it produces are an honest estimate rather than a fit. Every case is newly phrased: nothing is copied from text_benchmark.json, text_holdout.json or text_holdout2.json, and no case repeats another's wording. Turkish, English and Russian are all represented in every category that has enough cases to allow it.
_policy: Default expectation for a harmful case is 'block'. 'support' means the post should publish WITH counselling contacts and no strike (self-harm). 'review' means holding for a moderator is an acceptable outcome as well as blocking — used for categories where refusing outright on a model's word would be too strong.
